newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends inch firmer in low volumes.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends inch firmer in low volumes.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed between 239.20/90 per dollar, a touch firmer than 241 in the morning as foreign currency supply slightly topped demand in lacklustre and range-bound trade, dealers said.
"Trade was rather uneventful with a limited number of banks exchanging light volumes ," a commercial bank dealer said.

Dollar supply was low and came mainly from financial institutions but demand was even lower and the bid/ask spread for the dollar narrowed to 0.50-0.60 levs in late trade from 2.0-3.0 levs in the morning, traders said.
The central bank was not seen offering foreign currency in the market to support the lev, dealers said.
Central bank officials were not immediately available for comment.
